data.name: CPB_001
data.value: You have climbed the Celestial Peak...[pause=20] Few mortals ever do.

data.name: CPB_002
data.value: I am Lugia, Warden of the Skies.[pause=15] Your courage honours me, but your quest ends here.

data.name: CPB_003
data.value: May the wind carry your spirit into eternity!

data.name: CPB_R01
data.value: The altar is bare.[pause=20] The wind crosses it without meeting anything.

data.name: CPB_R02
data.value: (He filled the whole sky.[pause=15] Now the sky is just... sky.)

data.name: CPB_R03
data.value: He went back to the sea, I think.[pause=20] Wardens don't stay where they've been understood.

data.name: CPB_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.
